saw_lines: Nobody needs a plushie, so buyers pick one for the mood, then add a second for the collection.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a buyer decides whether the mood fits.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers up to 20% off, yet 0 of 21 ads mention percent off or any discount, so new buyers have no reason to act. Open three new ads with the weekend sale in line one and on the creative.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so a doubtful buyer has nothing to weigh before paying. Lead the next batch with the 4.9 rating from your site, and add a review count or orders shipped as line two.

Your 21 copy ads open with 15 different stories, and the biggest, “when everything looks this cute”, leads only 3, so buyers hear the same pitch twice. Pick the two best openers and build the next batch from them, three variations each.

Eight ads have run 60+ days, so they are proven winners, yet the newest batch starts from scratch. Build three variations of your oldest winner, keep the product and the best line, and test the 20% off weekend sale against it.
